items.information: Välkomna till Back to Square-1 in Rottne 2026! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. items.information: ## Welcome to the FMC Penang & Sprint 2026! [![Malaysia Cube Sports Association(MYCSA)](https://i.imgur.com/ZUv6wZJm.png)](https://www.mycubeassociation.org/competition/info/FMCPenangSprint2026) All competitors are advised to review the information provided in the ["**[IMPORTANT] Updates & Announcements**"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCPenangSprint2026#80595-important-updates-announcements). New competitors, in particular, should carefully read the ["**New Competitors**"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCPenangSprint2026#80596-new-competitors) for essential details before registering. Competitors should ***ensure that their email address registered with the WCA is valid and up-to-date***, as organizers will use it to send important competition updates and pre-competition information. ***Our schedule, cutoff & time limit is subject to change based on the number of registrants for each event; please pay close attention throughout the open registration period to see if our schedule has been adjusted.*** There will be special age categories and first timer categories for the 3x3x3 event first round: **Under 12 Category** - Top 3 winners from 3x3x3 event first round age 12 and under **Under 15 Category** - Top 3 winners from 3x3x3 event first round age 13 - 15 **Above 16 Category** - Top 3 winners from 3x3x3 event first round age 16 and above **First Timer** - All first timer competitors will received certificate of participation and top 3 winners from 3x3x3 event first round for first timer

items.name: Side Events under the Mistletoe FXBG 2026
items.information: **This competition only has side events and not 3x3x3 Cube, therefore, we do not recommend it for new competitors. If you're looking for a more conventional cubing competition, you might be interested in [other competitions in Virginia](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?search=Virginia); Such as [RVAutumn 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RVAutumn2026).** A location of FMC under the Mistletoe will be hosted during this competition. Registration is free, but must be completed seperately. See the [FMC under the Mistletoe Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FXBGMistletoe2026#81612-fmc-under-the-mistletoe) for more information. NO on the spot registrations will be honored for FMC. This competition will be using a different format than what is usually seen at competitions. See the [Competition Format Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FXBGMistletoe2026#81742-competition-format) for more information. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competitor Responsibilities tab. Additionally, we recommend you attend the Newcomers Tutorial at the beginning of the Competition.

items.name: Swisscubing Cup Final 2026
items.information: [DE] 🇩🇪 Dieses Turnier ist Teil des Swisscubing Cup 2026. Dieser nationale Wettbewerb, verteilt über 8 Competitions in der ganzen Schweiz, lässt die Teilnehmer Punkte in verschiedenen Events sammeln. Alle diese Punkte werden dann zu einem Ranking zusammengezählt. Der Begriff "Finale" kann irreführend sein, denn es ist nicht nötig, sich dafür zu qualifizieren. **Du kannst also an diesem Turnier teilnehmen, auch wenn du noch nie an einem Wettbewerb mit dem Namen "Swisscubing Cup" teilgenommen hast.** Weitere Infos hier: [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/) ______________________________________________________________________________________________ [EN] 🇬🇧 This tournament is part of the Swisscubing Cup 2026. This national competition, spread across 8 events throughout Switzerland, allows participants to collect points in various events. All these points are then totalled to produce a ranking. The term ‘final’ can be misleading, as there is no need to qualify for it. **So you can take part in this tournament even if you have never competed in an event called the “Swisscubing Cup” before.** Further information here: [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/) ______________________________________________________________________________________________ [FR] 🇨🇵 Ce tournoi fait partie de la Swisscubing Cup 2026. Cette compétition nationale, qui se déroule en 8 étapes à travers toute la Suisse, permet aux participants d'accumuler des points lors de différentes épreuves. Tous ces points sont ensuite additionnés pour établir un classement. Le terme « finale » peut prêter à confusion, car il n'est pas nécessaire de se qualifier pour y participer. **Tu peux donc participer à ce tournoi même si tu n'as encore jamais pris part à une compétition portant le nom de « Swisscubing Cup ».** Plus d'informations ici : [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/) ______________________________________________________________________________________________ [IT] 🇮🇹 Questo torneo fa parte della Swisscubing Cup 2026. Questa competizione nazionale, articolata in 8 gare in tutta la Svizzera, permette ai partecipanti di accumulare punti in diverse prove. Tutti questi punti vengono poi sommati per stilare una classifica. Il termine “finale” può trarre in inganno, poiché non è necessario qualificarsi per parteciparvi. **Puoi quindi partecipare a questo torneo anche se non hai mai preso parte a una competizione denominata «Swisscubing Cup».** Ulteriori informazioni qui: [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/)
